scripts.text: Judging from these results, you obviously have a problem with concentrating.
scripts.translation: 从结果来看，你显然不够专注。

scripts.text: If you can't even solve these easy word puzzles, how can you keep track of your experiments and research?
scripts.translation: 连这么简单的字母题都解不出来，以后怎么理清实验和研究中的各种细节？

scripts.text: You're carrying too much stuff! First, put some of your things in Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation: ..你带的东西太多了！先把一些物品存进卡普拉仓库吧。

scripts.text: There, you'll need to talk to ^551A8BBain^000000 and ^551A8BBajin^000000. Those two are doing Alchemy research with the Sages

scripts.text: in Juno. You'll learn something by assisting them with their project.

scripts.text: Come back here to me after you
help them out. They'll need all of these items to continue their experiments.

scripts.text: I just got a message from Bain
and Bajin. They let me know that they were very happy with your assistance.
scripts.translation: 和巴金的消息。他们说你的帮助让他们非常满意。
